name: media-pipeline
display_name: Media Pipeline - AI Image Generation (Gemini + OpenAI)
description: Generate AI images locally through a bundled dual-provider MCP server and standalone CLI, powered by Google Gemini or OpenAI (gpt-image-2).
long_description: A production-oriented MCP Bundle for local image generation workflows with dual-provider support for Google Gemini or OpenAI (gpt-image-2). The bundle exposes a create_asset MCP tool, validates requests defensively, uses bundled Node entry points for both the MCP server and the standalone CLI, and saves generated images directly to local disk for easy use in websites, documents, and presentations.

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Gemini API Key
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your Google Gemini API key. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. At least one of the Gemini or OpenAI API keys must be provided.

GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default Model
GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Preferred model for image generation. Available models are fetched dynamically from the Gemini API at runtime.

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API Key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. At least one of the Gemini or OpenAI API keys must be provided.

OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default OpenAI Model
OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Preferred OpenAI model for image generation.

IMAGE_PROVIDER.title: Default Provider
IMAGE_PROVIDER.description: Which provider (gemini or openai) to use when a request omits a model. Controls the default model's provider; explicit gpt-image*/dall-e* model names always route to OpenAI regardless of this setting.

IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output Directory
IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory where generated images will be saved. Leave blank to use a generated-images folder in your home directory.

GEMINI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request Timeout (ms)
GEMINI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum time to wait for image generation requests (applies to both Gemini and OpenAI)

MEDIA_PIPELINE_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MEDIA_PIPELINE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level written to stderr for diagnostics

tools.name: create_asset
tools.description: Generate an image with Google Gemini or OpenAI (gpt-image-2), save it locally, and return the output path plus structured metadata.
